title: Fate of Gaza Strip ‘eclipsed and forgotten’ amid Middle East war

snapshot.title: Fate of Gaza Strip ‘eclipsed and forgotten’ amid Middle East war
snapshot.description: GAZA CITY, Palestinian Territories: The Gaza war was the spark that touched off years of Middle East conflict culminating in the US-Israeli war with Iran, but as Washington and Tehran wrangle over terms for peace, the devastated territory’s fate seems largely out of mind. “Ever since the United States went to war with Iran, the whole world has forgotten Gaza and its tragedy.
snapshot.author: AFP
snapshot.pageTitle: Fate of Gaza Strip ‘eclipsed and forgotten’ amid Middle East war | Arab News
